balls.text: another wrong'un, another wicket and Mathews takes a sharp catch. Axar wants to whack it over the off side, skews it off the bottom of the bat and holes out to long-off, Mathews takes it at the edge of the boundary
googly and Tahir is delighted. Bailey chips down the track, does not middle the heaved strike. Iyer just about hangs onto it at deep midwicket
pushed through outside off and spins away. Bailey backs away, slugs but does not connect
zooter on middle and leg, squeezed down to long-on
pushed through, lofted over the bowler's head. Long-on, long-off converge, kept down to a couple
looped up and slow outside off, Axar swings wildly and misses
floated on the fourth-stump line, Bailey slithers across off, fetches it from there and lap-scoops it to the left of the keeper, fine on the leg side with a healthy helping of cheek
darted on middle and leg, Axar steps out and drills it to long-on
short and outside off, chopped to short third
Bailey into the act. He nips down the track, meets the pitch of this flighted ball on off and gives it marching orders over long-on
low full toss on middle, mis-hit reverse-sweep to short third
away she sails over the boundary.. Fuller and on middle, Axar goes down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over cow corner
tossed up googly from Tahir, Bailey chips it to the right of the bowler for a couple of runs
Axar steps out, takes it on the full and mis-hits the flick to midwicket for a scampered single
quicker and spins away, beats Axar on the slog sweep
fuller and on middle and leg, whippily driven down the ground
flat and on off, sliced in front of long-off
tossed up outside off, might have been a wrong'un, Bailey gets an outside edge to short third

Viru, Maxi and Miller depart in successive overs, and off the last deliveries! This was darted quick on middle, not too short. Miller aims for a meaty pull and only meets with thin air. This JPD offering thuds into the middle stump
angled on middle from round the stumps, chipped in front of long-on
leg-stumpish, Miller sinks to one knee and paddles it down to short fine. He nicks a single here
darted flat and miles wide outside off
slid down leg, and JPD escapes punishment. Paddled straight to short fine
floated on off, he uses his feet and works it to leg for a single
flatter and on off, tucked through midwicket for a couple
legbreak outside off and Tahir strikes! Maxi runs down the track, seeks to smash another mighty blow. But has to settle with a slice, which is swallowed up by Tiwary at the covers
dug in short and on the leg sump, Maxi backs away a smidge and marmalises a six over the man at deep midwicket
darted short on middle as Miller advances. Punched down to long-on for a single
dragged shortish on middle and leg, he nurdles a single in front of midwicket
And he has got his eye in. This was the rapid googly, Maxi clubs over deep midwicket with some authority
tossed up outside off, Maxi shuffles across off and scoops it fine to the left of the keeper. Getting your eye in, Maxi?

Sehwag has holed out, no fifty for him! This was pushed across Sehwag, he aims to loft it straight down the ground. But does not connect properly, slices it high into the air. Coulter-Nile makes good ground from deep cover, runs across and snaffles the take
Blisterin' barnacles! Round-armish and on a length, on off. Viru winds up and mows it over deep midwicket
swipe and a miss to a length ball outside off
angled wide outside off from round the stumps. Saw Viru wind up and pushed it outside off
nudged off the pads through midwicket
slid on a back of a length and on middle and leg, mis-hit pull in front of square on the leg side
pushed through outside off, squeezed to short third
fuller and on middle and leg, milked down to long-on

Amit Mishra knocks over Saha and roars, the partnership has been broken. This was hurled in on a yorker length, hurries onto Saha at 111ks. He goes low for a slog-sweep and is beaten on the bottom edge, Mishra thunks the off stump. Replays actually reveal that it was a seam-up delivery
dug in short on off, pulled away to long-on
pushed through outside off, Saha skips out and drills it over the umpire's head to long-on
looped up outside off, Sehwag lifts it over Saha, long-on mops up
flat and hurries on off, drags the slog-sweep in front of square on the leg side
Coulter-Nile finishes the over with a bouncer, bests Sehwag on the upper-cut
banged in short and climbs on off, dabbed in front of point
impressive strike from Saha. Creamed that one. Very full and on off, Saha gets under it and lofts it over the covers, skims over the boundary
pitched fuller and on off, sliced away to deep third man
on a length and outside off, Viru steps away, flashes and misses. He was done in by the slower ball
banged in short and rises on middle, hits the splice of the bat as Viru can't pull that away. Blocked in front of the bowler
arm-ball on middle, not a cuttable length. Sehwag takes a risk and cracks it towards deep extra
fuller and on off, Saha is down the track but does not meet the pitch of the ball, drags it towards long-on
stray one, down leg. Saha can't help it away with a pull
Yuvi darts it short, Sehwag mistimes a pull to long-on
low full toss on off, Saha sinks down to one knee and slog-sweeps it away to deep midwicket
back of a length, Saha makes some room and cuts it away towards sweeper cover
pushed through outside off, Yuvi draws the outside edge, that skitters away through the vacant slip cordon. Tahir runs back from short third and cuts it off to a couple
pitched up and skids through on off, patted in front of point for a single and Saha will keep strike
back of a length and on off, turned in front of midwicket
Saha skips out, Mathews bangs it short. Yet, Saha carries on with the pull, manages a top-edge and top-edges get sixes in T20s. Just about goes over deep midwicket
Sehwag was winding up, Mathews fires a full ball on off, whipped down to long-on
good length ball on off, dabbed in front of square on the leg side for a speedy single. Sehwag reciprocates though he doesn't like quick single
shortish in length, Viru loses his balance a bit, miscues the pull in front of long-on
pushed through outside off, spins in a touch, may have been a googly. Saha's attempted slog-sweep only meets with thin air
Viru unfurls a reverse-sweep, does not get hold of it. The ball dribbles in front of point
drags this short on off, Saha rocks back and pulls it away towards deep midwicket
slid through on off, Saha inches forward and defensively pushes it in front of point
darted flat on middle and leg, whipped to long-on
extra bounce on this outside off, back of a length. Viru bails out of the cut, rather belatedly
slid through on the stumps, cramps Viru for room, punched down to long-on. End of a productive over for KXIP- 18 off it
Sehwag is taking on Tahir. Slid through outside off, Sehwag cuts it, fillets the gap between short third and backward point
dragged short and wide outside off, encourages the cut. Sehwag hits it past a diving backward point
fuller and on off, Viru gets under and lofts it high and over long-off for a six
tossed up, he comes down the track and drives it towards long-on off an inside-edge
low full toss on off, Saha paddles it fine on the leg side
aha, Mishra slips in the googly. Gets some extra bounce as well. Sehwag blocks it back to the bowler off the inner part of the bat
fuller and outside off, driven smoothly past the covers
Saha uses his feet and converts a full ball into a full toss. Flicked to cow-corner. Iyer hits the stumps at the non-striker's and concedes an overthrow. Mishra isn't pleased
flat and darted in, whipped down to long-on
lobbed up outside off and spins away, past the tram-line. Saha does not want any of it
Saha chips out and eases this tossed up ball down to long-off
clipped down to mid-on for 4000 T20 runs, this was full and straight
off-speed fullish ball on off, clipped down to mid-on
good length and outside off, whisked in front of point
back of a length and swerves down leg. Saha gets across and does not get hold of the glance. Wided called
shortish and hurries on off, Sehwag mis-hits thje pull to mid-on. Viru and Saha nearly collided with each other
slash and miss to a back-of-a-length delivery outside off
banged in short and rises outside off, Sehwag sways away from the line of harm and leaves it
fuller and on middle and leg, Saha skips out, picks it up from there and deposits over the backward square leg boundary. Wristy stuff
picked off the pads, straight to short fine. They steal a single off an overthrow

pitched up and outside off, driven past the outstretched left hand of the bowler to mid-off. There is a miscommunication between the wickets. Saha is quick, but Viru is too sluggish. Duminy belatedly throws to the keeper's end but it is off-radar. A strong throw could have consumed Sehwag, who was ball-watching initially
on a length and skids through on middle and leg, blocked back to the bowler
very full and skids through on off, poked out towards backward point
fuller and on the stumps, pushed back to the bowler
Cross-seamer from Mathews. Shortish and rushes on outside off to ruin Vijay's attempted pull. He lobs it up in the air. Duminy runs across to his right from mid-off, dives and snags a smart catch
banged in shortish and on off, Vijay hops up and dabs it in front of point
fractionally back of a length and on off, Vijay, having stepped away, has ample leverage to lash it behind point. Third man can't cut that off
back of a length and outside off, flat-batted past the bowler. Mid-on moves to his left and has it covered
Mathews changes his pace and delivers a cutter, just about climbs over the off stump as Viru is early into the pull. Does not connect
width on offer outside off. Viru frees his arms and rifles it over backward point. Don't bother about the feet movement
deep midwicket in business again. This was full on middle and leg, Viru directs it to the fielder there with a flick of those wrists
low full toss now, whipped away through midwicket
Vijay backs away, Joseph is wary of it as he delivers a yorker, he can't dig that out. Off the back pad and runs away to the left of the keeper
back of a length and on the hips, whipped with the wrists through midwicket. There is protection in the deep, though
fuller and on middle and leg, Vijay gets an inside-edge, that sneaks away behind square on the leg side
length ball on middle, Vijay backs away and lifts it over the covers. Not middled, though
Sehwag finds his bearings right now. On a length and well outside off, Sehwag arches back, carves a cut in the air, up and over backward point. He gets off the mark after six balls
angled outside off on a back of a length, Sehwag flashes and is beaten. He wears a wry smile on his face
back of a length and rushes onto Sehwag, who is late onto the flick to leg
he goes wide of the crease and angles it full on off and middle, Sehwag is crease-bound as he defensively pushes it down the track
bumper, flies over a ducking Sehwag. Wide called, for there was too much height on that
back of a length and zipping through outside off, Sehwag throws his bat and watches the ball swoosh past the outside edge
shortish and comes back in on off, Sehwag stays back and blocks it back to Coulter-Nile
Vijay reaps reward for positive intent. He advances down the track, manufactures a length ball and annihilates a six over deep midwicket. Deposited into the stands!
back of a length and around off, bunted into the covers via an open face
dug in shortish and skids through on top of off, mis-hit pull to mid-on
fullish and outside off, Vijay drives and finds extra-cover
back of a length and on the leg stump, Vijay steps away, creates room and slogs it over a leaping mid-off off the inside half of the bat
pitched up and on off, Vijay is forward and across to tap it down to mid-on
Viru is defeated by the extra lift there. Back of a length and rears up outside off, Sehwag looks to force it away with no feet movement. He can't lay bat onto that
banged in short and rises outside off, Vijay rises with it, rides the bounce and glides it to the left of deep third man. Amit Mishra hunts the ball down in the deep
fullish and shapes away a touch outside off, he comes forward and drives it crisply and finds the man at the covers
Coulter-Nile shortens his length on off, brings this one back in. Vijay does not meet with the flick. Off the pad
on a length and outside off, Vijay has a nervy waft at it and is beaten emphatically
outswinger from Coulter-Nile, teases Vijay outside off. Vijay was late to drag his bat away, deflects it first slip on the bounce, off the face of the bat

DD break their 11-match winless streak, Mathews finishes it for DD. He nips down the track and drills it, beating mid-on to his left. Tiwary wraps Mathews in a hug. Albie shakes hands with JPD in the dug-out
mis-hit down to mid-on, straight to the fielder as this was darted short. Tiwary wants a single but is sent back. The fielder has a shy at the stumps and misses
DD have to wait for victory. This was pushed through, Jadhav aims to swipe it away. Does not get it off the meat of the bat. Skies it off a top-edge, which is held by Anureet at the covers
Mathews backs away, Axar fires it outside leg, punched down to long-off
length ball on of, Jadhav twirls his wrists and flicks it to the right of midwicket. Sensible batting
yorker outside leg, following Jadhav, who was backing away. Squirted in front of point
full and outside off, Mathews smears it over the covers. Anureet is caught overstepping last ball
another top yorker, he manages an inside-edge onto the pad and gets off the mark
angled on the pads, near yorker, which is clipped out to deep midwicket

two in two for Anureet. This is a soft, soft dismissal. Full toss outside leg as Mayank steps away. Instead of mowing it away, he misses. The ball brushes the front pad and disturbs the stumps. The off-bail is tipped off

Yuvraj goes deep in the crease, but holes out for 54. He has done his job for DD, though. This was very full from Anureet on off, Yuvraj shuffles across a bit, goes deep in the crease and swings it. Sandeep runs in from deep midwicket, keeps his eyes on the ball, dives forward and pulls off a superb catch. The umpires check for a no-ball and Anureet is okay, Yuvi has to go
yorker outside off, he can't dig it out
back of a length and outside off, Agarwal slaps it in the air. Anureet runs across to his left from deep cover, dives, but does not get to the ball. Can't even fingertip it away, that's a four
too full and wide outside off as Yuvi jumps across off again. Scythed up and over covers
low full toss, clipped to long-on
too full and wide outside off, crunched through the covers for one
Yuvi stands a foot wide outside off, Dhawan sprays it past the tram-line, another massive off-side wide
too full and wide outside off, Yuvraj drives but does not connect
Yuvraj steps away and makes room, Dhawan loses his radar as he slides it wide outside off
yorker on off, dug out to the covers
low full toss on the pads, eased to long leg
yorker, jabbed back at the bowler
slower short ball on the leg stump, Agarwal waits for his to arrive and pulls it in front of square. Maxi runs across to his right from deep midwicket, but can't prevent the boundary
round the wicket, stray ball down leg. Agarwal does not meet with the glance
should have been a free-hit. Back of a length and outside off, clunked away to deep cover

whacked over midwicket, fifty for Yuvraj. He raises his bat and acknowledges the cheers. Fuller and on the pads, whipped with the wrists over midwicket. That's a no-ball as well, but the umpire has missed it
short on the leg stump, helped fine with a pull
quick and on middle and leg, Yuvraj picks it up and deposits it over deep square. Flat and powerful
flatter and on off, swatted down to long-on
arm-ball on the pads, he nurdles a single behind square on the leg side
Yuvraj goes bang! Very full and outside off, not full enough. Yuvi gets under it, smokes the pants off it and launches it over long-on
slid through outside off, cut straight to point
darter outside off, driven away to deep extra cover
on the fuller side now, sliced over the covers
whoa! Top strike and Agarwal gets to a fifty with a pulled six. 148ks, near rib-cage rattler, Agarwal takes the bull by its horns and slap-pulls it away over deep backward square
Mitch bangs it short and down leg. Agarwal can't meet with the pull. Wide called
full and wide outside off, Agarwal throws his bat at it and slices it away to deep third man off a thick outside edge
shortish and leg-stumpish from round the stumps, helped away fine with a pull

sliced in the air and Sandy drops it. Full and wide outside off, Agarwal has a crack at it and skews it high in the air. Sandy rushes in from sweeper, dives forward, grasps it. But the ball popped out once his elbow hit the ground
full and outside off, Agarwal opens his bat face and drives it, bisecting backward point and deep third man
flat and full on off, punched back at Axar
low full toss on the leg stump, whipped away towards long-on. Miller releases it quickly, but Kings XI needed a direct hit there
mis-timed pull to mid-on as this Axar offering hurries on. Bailey flings to his left and makes a fine half-stop
yorker at the base of off, he jabs his bat down and digs it out
leg-stumpish, Yuvraj can't help it away with a paddle and is rapped on the pad. This pitched outside leg, though
flat and on off, he sinks to one knee and slogs it away in front of long-on
banged in short and on the stumps, pulled over midwicket off the back foot
shortish, cramps Yuvraj for room. He seeks to pull and gets a bottom-edge in front of midwicket. The pair sneak in a single by the time Dhawan collects the ball

pitched up and outside off, Yuvraj unwraps another drive from the past, sends it whistling through the covers. Vijay runs across to his left from sweeper, slides and takes all the sheen off the shot, restricting it to two
full and outside off, driven to the right of mid-off
back of a length and sliding across Yuvraj, beaten on the cut
classy from Yuvraj. This was on a fuller length and outside off, he he gets under it and lofts it beautifully over mid-off, who was inside the circle
taps in front of the covers and hustles across for a single
short from Maxi, Axar goes for a pull and drags it to long-on
slid through outside off, drifts away, Agawal is beaten on the cut
length ball outside off, Agarwal goes down one one knee and swipes over long-on. Superb connection
flat and darted, whipped down to long-on
pushed through outside off, guided to short third
Mitch hammers it short on off, Yuvi leaps off his feet to fend it into the pitch
Yuvi hops up, rides the bounce of this short ball outside off and steers it in front of point
Mitch errs in line and length. This was too full and on the leg stump, Yuvraj eases it away to the fine leg boundary. Easy pickings, that
shortish and hurries on top of middle, yet he has ample time to steer it down to third man
whipped off the pads behind square on the leg side
pitched further up and outside off, Yuvraj leans forward and caresses it to the long-off fence after beating mid-off's dive. Caresses it, I stress that again
back of a length and outside off, carved to deep third man off a thick outside edge
dug in short and on off as Yuvi steps out. He adjusts and steers it towards backward point
short and outside off, Yuvraj takes it from there and pulls it away to the left of mid-on. Sandy did not have pace to pose a threat that
fuller and swings in on middle and leg, clipped straight to mid-on
pitched up and comes in a touch on middle, pushed to backward point
fuller and outside off, he reaches out and crashes it to Miller at the covers
pitched up and on off, lures Yuvi into a drive. The thick outside edge sneaks away to deep third man
rip-snorter from Mitch! Bouncer outside off, Yuvraj hops up, sways away and gets his noggin out of the way. Saha leaps and collects the ball. Excellent govework from Saha
back of a length and outside off, steered to third man
banged in short and hurries outside off to surprise Yuvraj, who gets into a tangle and squirt-edges it down towards third man
short on the hips, Yuvi hops up and tucks it fine on the leg side. Anureet slides in the deep, but his effort ends in vain
pitched up and on off, sliced over the covers. Sweeper cover hunts that down
fuller and outside off, he lasers a drive to long-off
whipped away off the pads to long-on
slid through on middle and leg, blocked back to the bowler
pushed in front of point for a single

has JPD been run-out? This was slid through on the stumps, pushed down the ground by Agarwal. Axar dives across and deflects it back onto the non-strikers' all in one motion. During the process, Axar had collided with JPD, who was thrown off balance and lost his bat, half-diving, half-falling, before landing on his right hand. Looks like the bails came off the groove before JPD landed on his right hand and made his ground. The TV umpire examines it from various angles and gives it OUT! Misfortune for JPD, who had taken a start, turned back and tripped off, colliding with Axar. Sharp work from the bowler, though
a big shout for lbw! Angled flatter and quicker on the leg stump, JPD misses the sweep and wears it on the pad. That did not threaten the stumps
darted just outside off, dabbed down to third man, skiddy pace from Anureet
pitched up and outside off, JPD slices a drive through cover-point
back of a length and outside off, Agarwal angles his bat and glides it to third man
short and wide outside off, JPD flashes a cut to the off-side sweeper
Dhawan bends his back and bangs a bouncer. JPD watches it all along before sinking under that
good length delivery around off, JPD inches forward and bunts it in front of point
back of a length and outside off, he hangs back and punches it to point, where Miller flings to his right and half-stops the ball. The pair sneak in a single
good length ball skids through just outside off, punchily blocked to mid-on
hurled on a length and angled on the fourth-stump line, steered down to deep third man
back of a length and swerves in on off, punched to point via an open face
back of a length and outside off, helped down to deep third man. JPD exploited Mitch's pace to his advanatage
beautifully placed, JPD brings his wrists into play. Fuller and straighter, flicked in the gap between midwicket and mid-on. The vintage timing carries it to the boundary
on a length and outside off, Sandy draws another outside edge as JPD pushes at it. The outside edge runs away to third man
overpitched and outside off, JPD lays into a crackin' drive. The man at covers dives and takes some pace off the ball, deflecting it past mid-off. Dhawan runs back, chases and limits it to a couple
full again, floated wide outside off. JPD reaches out for the drive, gets a thick outside edge past the lone slip fielder
fullish and on off, skids through to Agarwal, who dabs it in front of point for an urgent single
full and skids through outside off, JPD waits on it before steering it to third man
on a good length and zipping through the channel outside off, JPD chases it with a weak drive and watches the ball pass the outside edge
shortish and on the stumps, he pivots on the back foot. Mis-times a pull in the air, to the right of Miller at midwicket
on a length and on middle, pushed down the track for one
too full and outside off, JPD comes forward and toe-ends a drive to mid-off
shortish and outside off, sits up to be hit. This is a belated birthday gift, he rocks back and pulls it over midwicket
back of a length and nips away off the deck with some excess lift. JPD spars at it and gets beaten
pitched up and outside off, driven into the covers
Agawal dabs this back-of-a-length ball on off to point
another off-side wide

banged in short and rushes onto tuck Iyer up for room. He was caught between pulling and pulling out of the stroke. He gets into an awkward tangle and guides it to Anureet at deep third man off the bottom part of the bat
very full and on off, Iyer gets under it and lofts it over the bowler's head. Not all that well-timed, Johnson keeps it to a couple
fuller and outside off, Iyer wanted to have a crack at it, but reins in his impulse and shoulders arms
very full and drifts in on off, Iyer clips it away between midwicket and mid-on. Good connection and the ball skips away to the boundary
pitched up and straightens a touch outside off, he lets it pass for the keeper
and again! Sandeep hunts for a big outswinger and pushes another off-side wide
very full and floated far too wide outside off, Iyer does not want any of it
length ball on off stump, defended to mid-off
again he gets it to straighten from a good length on off stump, and again Iyer is opened up a touch as he pokes it towards mid-off

length ball on a fourth-stump line, and Rishi Dhawan makes a hash of this at third man. Opens his bat face to steer it, and Dhawan slid to stop it and ended up sliding past the ball, which runs away to the boundary. Outfield may have been slippery with dew
length ball angling into middle stump. Agarwal looks for the flick over the on side, had to bring his bat around a halfway planted front leg, and just about cleared mid-on in the end
shortish outside off, not short enough to pull. Early into his shot and he hits it to mid-on, not off the meat of the bat
good ball, on a length, straightens towards off stump. Agawal wanted to play that into the on side, and adjusted late to push it to mid-off
length ball fairly wide outside off, on the fuller side, driven to cover point
outswinger this time, starts fairly wide outside off, left alone
back of a length outside off, no swing, steered away to the right of third man
take that. Another inswinger, but the line is far enough outside off for Agarwal to be able to plonk his front foot across and swing freely to launch it, with the swing, over wide mid-on
fullish ball outside off, driven firmly to mid-off
and here it is, first up. Agarwal got his front pad across to try and flick it into the leg side. All he managed was to interest the bowler in a big lbw appeal, not given
